title: Layer videos, picture-in-picture and green screen
summary: Put several video clips on video tracks: a clip on a higher track is drawn in front. Right-click a video clip and choose Video effects and layout... for green screen and layout.
alternateQueries: How do I do a green screen?
How do I put a small video over another?

blocks.text: Video clips that overlap in time are layered. A clip on a track higher in the list is drawn in front of one lower down.

blocks.title: Open a clip's effects and layout

steps.instruction: Right-click the video clip and choose Video effects and layout...

blocks.definition: Turn on Remove the key colour to make that colour see-through, so the layer underneath shows. Key colour picks the colour to remove; Soft edge feathers the edge; Spill cleanup reduces the coloured fringe.
Sets where the clip sits and how big and opaque it is, so a small video can float over a larger one.

blocks.text: Reset everything returns the clip's settings to their defaults. The settings are saved with the clip.
